## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -12.41%) BELOW TREND showing fear easing (↓ falling) and HYG/LQD signalling CREDIT STRESS ↑ (HYG (1W: -0.18% | 1M: +0.17%) CORRECTION; LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.41%) BELOW TREND), with SPY (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.21%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +0.01%) CORRECTION giving mixed stock-vs-bond signals (→ flat / RECOVERY).

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear decreasing: VXX (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -12.41%) BELOW TREND (↓ falling). Credit stress rising: Credit Spread 0.7505 (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +0.57%) → flat with HYG/LQD mixed (HYG CORRECTION / LQD BELOW TREND).

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tight: Dollar strength muted (Dollar 28.08, 1W: -0.14% | 1M: +0.04% → flat | CORRECTION) and yield curve shallow (Yield Curve 1.0064, 1W: -0.05% | 1M: -0.30% → flat | BELOW TREND), TLT (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +0.01%) in CORRECTION.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND and Utilities strength (XLU prox. 1W: +2.10% | 1M: +0.81%) ABOVE TREND; Financials mixed: XLF (1W: +0.43% | 1M: -0.22%) RECOVERY. Tech/XLK (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +1.05%) ABOVE TREND but sector breadth shows Technology weak overall, so style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
Emerging markets outperform: EEM (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +5.66%) ABOVE TREND outpacing SPY (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.21%) ABOVE TREND; China FXI (1W: +1.04% | 1M: -0.19%) RECOVERY.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation intact: IBIT (1W: +3.03% | 1M: +23.95%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +1.93% | 1M: +13.85%) ABOVE TREND, while small caps IWM (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -0.75%) RECOVERY.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity strength broad: USO (1W: +9.45% | 1M: +19.42%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%) ABOVE TREND lead, CPER (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -1.99%) RECOVERY; gold GLD (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +4.39%) CORRECTION on profit taking.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy trending up: XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND (↑ rising) and nat gas UNG (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +9.66%) ABOVE TREND (↑ rising).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Risk appetite signals from VXX falling and EM/commodities strength (EEM, XLE ABOVE TREND) support risk. Divergence: Narrow breadth 4/11 and rising credit stress (HYG/LQD mixed) create a notable headwind and minor divergence versus equity breadth.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to Energy (XLE) and EM equities (EEM) while reducing exposure to weak cyclicals/industrial discretionary (XLI (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND; XLY (1W: -1.96% | 1M: -2.70%) BELOW TREND); monitor credit spreads and VXX.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND, EEM (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +5.66%) ABOVE TREND, IBIT (1W: +3.03% | 1M: +23.95%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLY (1W: -1.96% | 1M: -2.70%) BELOW TREND, XLI (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND, LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.41%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: USO (1W: +9.45% | 1M: +19.42%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%) ABOVE TREND, UNG (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +9.66%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: WEAT (1W: -5.39% | 1M: +11.68%) CORRECTION and SLV (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +7.11%) CORRECTION on short-term pullbacks.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~18 marks current complacency (VXX (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -12.41%) BELOW TREND). HYG/LQD spread ~0.75 flags credit risk (Credit Spread 0.7505, 1W: +0.00% | 1M: +0.57% → flat). Breadth 4/11 signals narrow market internals to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive and VXX falling vs rising credit stress create a mixed backdrop. Energy (XLE) and EM (EEM) showing strength while narrow breadth and credit stress remain the key risks to watch.
